description: The proposal seeks planning permission for the change of use of the existing ancillary outbuilding, currently serving the primary dwellinghouse, to a self-contained short-term rental unit operating independently of the main dwellinghouse on a year-round basis. The existing building will be retained, with remedial and adaptation works undertaken as necessary to facilitate the proposed use. No extension or increase in the building's footprint is proposed. External alterations may be required where necessary to meet relevant fire safety and building performance requirements. Additional external works will include appropriate boundary treatment to provide privacy and separation between the proposed rental unit and the primary dwellinghouse, whilst maintaining suitable independent access to the accommodation. Internal works will comprise the fit-out of the existing building to provide open-plan studio-style accommodation, incorporating a sleeping area, living space, a fully functioning kitchen and a new bathroom, forming a self-contained unit for short-term guest accommodation.
